project.generation_method: Generate every scene as a completely independent 10-second video.
critical_workflow_rule: Start a NEW Gemini chat for every scene.
Do NOT attach the previous scene video when generating the next scene.
Do NOT use Extend, Continue, Edit, Remix, or video-to-video generation.
Generate one independent 10-second MP4 per JSON file.
Combine the 12 MP4 files only after all scenes are generated.

critical_instruction: Use a NEW Gemini chat for every scene. Never attach or extend the previous generated video.
final_assembly: Combine the 12 downloaded MP4 files in a conventional video editor after generation.
